Q935.reason: Under the Restatement a promise to pay a time-barred debt is generally binding without new consideration, and the statute of frauds does not apply to a promise performable within a year, so the barred status of the debt is the strongest ground for unenforceability.

Q936.reason: AHA and ERC guidelines call for chest compressions at 100 to 120 per minute, and 100/minute is the option within that range.

Q937.reason: Morphine relieves pain but causes sedation as a well-known side effect.
